name: spritecast
description: Game props and characters at their real size and exact camera angle, drawn in your art style - props, standing figures, and 8-direction walking characters (3D-guided).

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Drawing props and characters (about $0.07 a prop, $2.2 a walking character). From platform.openai.com. Or give a fal or OpenRouter key below instead.

fal_key.title: fal.ai API key (instead of OpenAI)
fal_key.description: The same OpenAI image model, billed by fal.ai. From fal.ai/dashboard/keys.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key (instead of OpenAI)
openrouter_api_key.description: The same OpenAI image model, billed by OpenRouter. From openrouter.ai/settings/keys.

image_provider.title: Image provider (optional)
image_provider.description: openai, fal or openrouter. Empty: the first of them whose key is set.

tripo_api_key.title: Tripo API key (optional)
tripo_api_key.description: Walking characters and animals: the 3D model and its rig (75 / 30 credits). From platform.tripo3d.ai.

meshy_api_key.title: Meshy API key (optional)
meshy_api_key.description: Only if you choose Meshy as the 3D modeller ("modeler": "meshy").
